providers.authenticity_policy: Retain the provider's attributed grade verbatim. No inferred, upgraded or independently assigned grade.
providers.commentary_policy: Hadith text and published translation are distinct from explanation, benefits, vocabulary, notes and scholarly references.
providers.missing_translation_policy: Keep Arabic records and explicit missing-English status. Never generate translations.

providers.quotation_policy: Dorar wording stays attributed to Dorar; it never replaces canonical HadeethEnc wording.
Existing collection IDs remain attributed references; use linked HadeethEnc IDs for canonical quotations where mapped.
Hadith quotations inside books are book content and cannot silently replace canonical HadeethEnc quotations.

quran_policy: Quran editions, translations, tafsir and recitations retain their own independent provenance and designation. This registry sets precedence for hadith only.
citation_policy: Retain HadeethEnc provider ID, language, official page URL, original collection references, acquisition provenance and provider revision when supplied.
